Definition: {a Parsite (i.e. Persian), or inhabitant of Peres}
BiblicalUsage: Parsiy is the Persian, an inhabitant of Persia. It appears once, in Daniel 6:28, where Daniel prospers in the reign of Darius the Mede and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian, after the night in the lions' den.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Daniel outlasted two kings and one den of lions, and his prosperity was God's doing, not the court's.
